ivacaftor.chembl_note: 0 ABCG2 records; CFTR corrector, not a known ABCG2 ligand (specificity check)

elacridar.chembl_note: IC50 410 nM, potent ABCG2 inhibitor (reference negative control)

vorinostat.chembl_note: 0 ChEMBL ABCG2 inhibition records. HDAC inhibitor; scattered literature reports HDAC inhibitors as ABCG2 substrates, but no ChEMBL inhibition record and no canonical clinical ABCG2-substrate designation. Remains the sole marginal 'uncertain' docking hit (margin +0.55); not disqualified by Axis 2, but its fold-selectivity margin is within Vina noise.

rosuvastatin.chembl_note: 0 ChEMBL ABCG2 INHIBITION records — BUT rosuvastatin is a well-documented ABCG2/BCRP SUBSTRATE (ABCG2 Q141K raises rosuvastatin plasma AUC ~1.6-2x; the canonical ABCG2 statin-pharmacogenomics case, in the FDA label). ChEMBL's inhibition-only data structurally misses this. DISQUALIFIED as a chaperone candidate on substrate grounds (interpretive overlay): a molecule that is itself an ABCG2 substrate would compete with urate for efflux. Its docking 'uncertain' tier (margin +0.54) is retained in the raw pipeline output but overridden to non-candidate in interpretation.

avacopan.chembl_note: 0 ChEMBL ABCG2 inhibition records. C5aR1 antagonist; the #1 raw fold-site binder (fold_q141k -7.82) but margin only +0.28 — did NOT reach the 'uncertain' tier. No known ABCG2 relationship.

novobiocin.chembl_note: 7 records, action_type INHIBITOR, IC50 25-85 uM (weak but documented ABCG2 inhibitor)
